Type: rectangular wood framed mirror
Use: dressing, decorating a wall; bedroom, living room, above a dresser or sideboard
Style: mid-century modern, minimalist, traditional
Materials: walnut-finish wood frame, mirror glass
Colors: warm dark walnut brown, silver mirror
Shape: wide landscape rectangle, slim straight frame with clean beveled edges, large but understated
Feel: warm, calm, timeless
Goes with: walnut furniture, cream walls, brass accents; mid-century or classic bedrooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Jonathan Mid-Century Modern Mirror Wood Frame, 52", Walnut
product.description: This mirror mounts onto the classic mid-century modern Henley Dresser - and will have you reveling in retro style as you get dressed each morning. 52"W x 1.63"D x 40"H Beveled mirror glass Easy assembly in 15 minutes; just bolt to dresser Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
